# Hermes Agent FAQ & Troubleshooting Guide

## 1. General & Web UI
- **Web UI:** Run `hermes dashboard` to launch the web interface at `http://127.0.0.1:9119` with embedded browser chat.
- **Tracing / Call Chain:** Bundled opt-in Langfuse integration. Enable via `hermes tools` or `hermes plugins enable observability/langfuse` to inspect turn traces and tool parameters.
- **Reporting Vulnerabilities:** Report via GitHub Security Advisories or email `security@nousresearch.com` per `SECURITY.md`.

---

## 2. Model Providers & Auth
- **Local Ollama Overridden by Env Keys (401 error):** `provider: auto` detects environment keys (e.g. `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`). Set `provider: custom` with `base_url: http://localhost:11434` in `~/.hermes/config.yaml`.
- **Ollama Cloud 404:** Use the built-in `ollama-cloud` provider, which routes to OpenAI-compatible `https://ollama.com/v1`.
- **Small Local Models (4B–9B) Slow:** Tool schema (~45 tools) is sent every turn. Disable unused toolsets with `hermes tools`, use faster quantization, larger models (32B+), or set `terminal.backend: local`.
- **Custom / Ollama Vision:** Set `supports_vision: true` under your model config to enable native image payloads.
- **Azure AI Foundry:** Run `hermes setup` or set `provider: azure-foundry` (auto-detects `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL`). Claude Code-specific env vars are ignored.
- **Claude Pro/Max vs. API Billing:** API keys are always billed as API usage. Authenticate via OAuth to utilize Pro/Max subscriptions.
- **Google Gemini OAuth:** `google-gemini-cli` OAuth was removed due to upstream policy bans. Use Google AI Studio with `GOOGLE_API_KEY` or `GEMINI_API_KEY`.
- **DeepSeek V4 Charges:** Ensure Hermes is updated so `deepseek-v4-flash` is not force-normalized to `deepseek-chat` / `deepseek-v4-pro`.
- **LocalAI / OpenAI Stream Usage:** Streaming automatically sends `stream_options: {include_usage: true}` so `/usage` tracks tokens.
- **Open WebUI Streaming:** Tool progress SSE events are forwarded natively via `_on_tool_progress`.

---

## 3. Extensibility & Policy
- **Model Routing Policy:** Complexity-based auto model routing is not supported. Subagents are configured via `delegation.provider` / `delegation.model` in `config.yaml` or switched manually with `/model`.
- **Custom Memory Providers:** In-tree additions to `plugins/memory/` are closed. Standalone plugins can be placed in `~/.hermes/plugins/` implementing the `MemoryProvider` ABC (`sync_turn`, `prefetch`, `shutdown`).
- **Custom Tools:** Create personal tools as plugins in `~/.hermes/plugins` (`hermes plugins enable <name>`). Core development uses `tools/*.py` registered in `toolsets.py`.

---

## 4. Agent Loops, Persona & Memory
- **Turn Limits & Autonomy:** Default cap is `agent.max_turns: 90` (CLI: `hermes chat --max-turns <N>`). For persistent execution across sessions, use `/goal` (Ralph loop) and resume with `/goal resume`.
- **Context Compaction:** Old tool outputs are pruned by `ContextCompressor`. Custom strategies plug into `context.engine`.
- **Subagents:** Spawn concurrent subagents (up to 3 by default) via `delegate_task`.
- **Agent Memory Files:**
  - `SOUL.md`: Base agent persona and backstory.
  - `USER.md` (`target="user"`): User profile, identity, and preferences.
  - `MEMORY.md`: Knowledge base and general facts.
  - Skill execution stats are stored in `~/.hermes/skills/.usage.json` and viewed via `/insights` or `hermes insights`.

---

## 5. Gateway & Messaging Integrations
- **Gateway Setup Wizard:** Run `hermes gateway setup` for interactive setup of Discord, Telegram, etc.
- **Telegram "Unauthorized user":** `allowed_chats` is only for group chat IDs. For DM access, set `allow_from: "<USER_ID>"` (or `TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS`), use `hermes pairing approve telegram <CODE>`, or set `allow_all: true`.
- **Per-Channel Personas:** Use `channel_prompts` in config to set custom prompts per channel on Discord, Telegram, Slack, and Mattermost.
- **Multi-Profile Multiplexing:** Multiple accounts/profiles (e.g., Weixin, Telegram) can be served by a single gateway while keeping sessions and credentials isolated.
- **File Delivery & MCP Media:** Inbound `.py`/`.txt` attachments are injected into prompt context. Outbound local files and MCP `MEDIA:<path>` images dispatch to Telegram, Matrix (`m.file`), and Email (SMTP). DingTalk supports markdown images `![image](url)`.
- **Session Reset:** Crash/interrupted sessions preserve state as `resume_pending` (auto-reset defaults to `mode: none`). Restore via `/resume`.

---

## 6. Installation & Platforms
- **Windows:** Native Windows 10/11 is Tier 1 supported via `install.ps1` without WSL2 (WSL2 is only needed for Dashboard POSIX PTY `/chat`).
- **Docker / NAS Permissions:** Pass `PUID` and `PGID` (or `HERMES_UID`/`HERMES_GID`) to prevent `Permission denied` on `/opt/data`. Multi-arch Docker natively supports `linux/arm64`.
- **Android / Termux:** Native support using `scripts/install.sh` (`.[termux-all]` dependencies) and writable `TMPDIR`.
- **Honcho Local Memory:** Connecting to `localhost` / `127.0.0.1` auto-injects a placeholder key to prevent API key errors.
- **Slow Updates:** Delays during `hermes update` Node.js step are caused by silent Camofox binary downloads.
